ai_summary: Cipla reported strong Q2FY27 results with sequential revenue growth and improved EBITDA margins, driven by record-high domestic sales and sequential improvement in North America with key generic Advair approval. The company is actively bolstering its pipeline with strategic biosimilar partnerships and targeting an ambitious $1 billion annualized revenue run rate for North America by fiscal year-end through accelerated product launches. A notable red flag is the 7 FDA Form 483 observations at its Pithampur facility, which could pose material regulatory risks if not promptly resolved, potentially impacting future manufacturing and supply capabilities.
